title: UAAP: Pagdulagan makes triumphant return as NU routs Adamson
summary: Cielo Pagdulagan made a triumphant return to UAAP action as National University overpowered Adamson University, 71-51, in their first game of the Season 89 women's basketball tournament on Wednesday.
